display.purpose: Page-level titles: track title, top card titles.

body.purpose: Instructional and conversational copy, tip-jar messages.

label.purpose: Uppercase micro-labels: telemetry labels, field captions.

telemetry.purpose: Any live-updating number: BPM, timecodes, durations.

shadows.name: signal-glow-brass
shadows.purpose: Active/focused transport control or primary CTA — the one deliberate saturated glow, never a neutral drop shadow.

shadows.name: signal-glow-cyan
shadows.purpose: Active playhead or in-motion indicator glow.

motion.name: ease-out-console
motion.purpose: Default easing for all state transitions (hover, open/close, tab switch) — ease-out-expo, no bounce.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Micro state changes: hover, focus ring.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action: Process, Download, Generate click track, Split.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #d4a359; color: #241a04; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 500; border: none; transition: background 100ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e5b869; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d4a359; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action alongside a primary brass button (e.g. "Just download the file").
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: #f8fafc; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); transition: background 100ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #1a243b; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d4a359; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Telemetry Readout
components.description: The Key/Tempo/Time badges in the edit header — colored status dot plus a monospace tabular-nums value.
components.css: .ds-telemetry { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #131b2e; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 12px; } .ds-telemetry-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #d4a359; } .ds-telemetry-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #94a3b8; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-telemetry-value { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #f8fafc; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Segmented Tab (pill)
components.description: Trim / Metronome / Split mode switcher in the edit header — the one place full-pill radius is correct.
components.css: .ds-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: #94a3b8; font-size: 14px; margin-right: 8px; transition: background 100ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 100ms; } .ds-tab-active { background: rgba(212,163,89,0.15); color: #d4a359; border-color: rgba(212,163,89,0.4); } .ds-tab:hover:not(.ds-tab-active) { color: #f8fafc; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Standard content container: one tonal step off canvas, no shadow, hairline border.
components.html:
Trimmer

Drag the gold handles below to pick where your clip starts and ends.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #131b2e; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; color: #f8fafc; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 4px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #94a3b8; margin: 0; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text/number inputs: ms-precision trim fields, search box, form fields.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Search by title, artist…" />
components.css: .ds-input { background: #0e1524; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 12px; color: #f8fafc; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #d4a359; }

components.description: Success/error toast pairing the happy or sad mascot avatar with the message — the signature delight pattern.

narrative.overview: MD Tools is a real mixing console at soundcheck: brass-and-gold transport controls, cyan waveform telemetry, and a crew that still cracks jokes between cues. It is not a generic SaaS admin panel and it is not a cold, silent instrument — it's a precision tool with a personality. Density stays console-tight where it matters and opens up to plain-language breathing room everywhere a first-time user needs orientation. Personality lives at the edges, never inside the controls themselves.
keyCharacteristics: Dark obsidian canvas, permanently — this is a console, consoles don't have a light mode.
Brass/gold is the one warm accent; teal and cyan are cold signal colors, never decorative.
Every numeric readout is monospace with tabular figures — it must never jitter.
Delight (mascot, tip jar, playful copy) is confined to secondary moments, never inside primary controls.

rules.name: The Signal, Not Decoration Rule
rules.body: Teal and cyan never appear as generic accent color on a button, badge, or link "just because it looks nice." Teal means safe/engaged. Cyan means active/in-motion.

rules.name: The No-Jitter Rule
rules.body: Any number that can change while the user is looking at it is set in JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Tonal-Tier-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from moving up the canvas → rack → strip → dock ladder plus a hairline ring, never a box-shadow.

dos: Do keep the canvas permanently dark (#0c121e base).
Do use Orchestral Brass as the only warm accent, reserved for primary actions and active/focused state.
Do use Phosphor Emerald only for safe/engaged signals and Studio Cyan only for active/in-motion signals.
Do set every live numeric readout in JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums.
Do pair every success/error state with the happy or sad mascot.
Do use 4px hardware-radius corners on buttons/inputs and 8px on cards/panels; reserve full-pill radius for genuine mode-switch controls.
donts: Don't build a generic SaaS card-grid dashboard.
Don't use a side-stripe border accent on any card, list item, or alert.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism as a default, or a bouncy/elastic easing curve.
Don't let delight leak into the actual editing controls.
